name: 03-two-missed-weeks
about: A dumbbell trainee at Standard tracking who trained twice a week for five weeks, then missed two full weeks (no sessions, check-ins or weigh-ins) and is back today.

e1rm.why: Goblet squat with no RIR logged: only top sets of 10 reps or fewer count (11 and 12 are left out). Six points, best-of-3 80.00 lb against 73.33: +9.09 %, up. The two-week gap does not enter: the trend runs on sessions, not days.
DB bench: five qualifying top sets (8-10 reps); best-of-3 52.00 lb, +14.29 % over 3 sessions: up.

progression.why: Last top set before the break, 60 x 10, is inside 8-12: same weight, one more rep (60 x 11). This is the plain double progression; the missed-time protocol (below) adjusts it for the first week back.

Last top set 40 x 12 reached the top: 40 + 5 = 45 lb x 8, assuming every set reached 12 (Standard tracking). One 5 lb step is 12.5 % of 40 lb, so the load cap allows it once as a big jump: start at the bottom of the range.

volume.why: A missed week: no sessions from 2026-03-09 to 2026-03-15, so no sets for any muscle; every muscle is below the minimum dose.
The two missed weeks together: zero sessions, zero sets.

readiness.why: Check-ins every day from 2026-01-19 to 2026-03-08, then none until today. Today's baseline window (2026-02-23 to 2026-03-22) holds exactly 14 entries, the minimum, so every signal is scored. The 15-day gap since the last scored day is over 3 days, so the smoothed score restarts from today's R (S = R = +1.204).

weight.why: Daily weigh-ins to 2026-03-08, a 15-day gap, then 77.4 kg today. The gap uses 1 - 0.9^15 = 0.794 of the new reading, so the trend jumps to 77.18 kg. The 28-day slope (28 days, 15 weigh-ins) is +0.31 %/wk against the recomposition band -0.5 to 0 %: above.

missed.why: Last session 2026-03-05, back 2026-03-23: 17 days off, 2 whole weeks. The first week back (03-23 to 03-29) is 10 % lighter, rounded to the 5 lb step, at RIR +1: goblet 60 x 11 becomes 55 x 11 (54 rounds up), DB bench 45 x 8 becomes 40 x 8 (40.5 rounds down). The last session was a Dumbbells B day, so A is next.
